args.description: one single empty flight of enormous stone steps seen from directly beside it, strict flat side profile like a technical elevation drawing. Six steps of huge rough grey blocks climbing to the right, each riser far taller than a normal stair, the front faces chipped and worn, deep shadow under each overhang, moss in the joints. Nobody on the steps and nothing else in the picture. Palette of cool grey stone. Retro 16-bit pixel art, crisp pixels, flat readable shapes, no anti-aliasing.
